record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare FIRE_LASH: Salandit (1 star, range 2), Salazzle (2 stars, range 2) and Heatmor (3 stars, range 1); maxPP 100 and passive NONE for all in the catalog. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (damage table index) and range.
record.summary: Single-target ability. As written, the strategy (1) calls triggerArmorReduction(4000, target) on the cast target, passing the TARGET itself as the entity argument, and (2) requests SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/120/240 by the caster's stars) from the caster. Rune Protect on the target prevents the armor reduction (the damage is then divided by the full SPE_DEF); otherwise the halved SPE_DEF applies to this same hit because the status is set first. The duration reductions (Swift Swim, Hydration, Water Veil / Surge Surfer, Odd Keystone) read the target, so a target with those effects gets a shorter armor reduction; the caster's own effects do not matter. Protect, skydiving and magicBounce on the target are not cleared and block the damage (the armor reduction is still applied); a magicBounce target also queues a delayed SPECIAL bounce at the caster unless the caster holds Protective Pads.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not traced beyond the attacking-state gate.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost is passed as true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit, which requires EffectEnum.ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false
effects.resolution: requested amount = raw x AP factor [x crit]. If the armor reduction was applied (the target has no Rune Protect) handleDamage uses Math.round(speDef / 2) while it lasts, so the division is by that halved SPE_DEF; if Rune Protect prevented it the full SPE_DEF is used. The division is an intermediate calculation (ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers follow, so it is not the final HP loss; takenDamage (not used by this strategy, the return value is discarded) would count HP removed plus shield damage. Blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target (takes 0).

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit, none from stars
statusEffects.guards: not applied if the TARGET's status has runeProtect (checked on the status the method is called on). When applied, the duration goes through applyStatusDurationReductions(duration, pkm) where pkm is the target itself (supplied as the entity argument): SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3 (Math.round), and each Odd Keystone in the target's player's items takes a further 10 % off. Unlike RAGING_BULL (which passes the caster), the caster's effects and items do not shorten it. A new application replaces the remaining time only if longer. Read from source; the pinned helper was not executed in this run.
statusEffects.combatEffect: while set, handleDamage uses Math.round(def / 2) and Math.round(speDef / 2) for the damage division (WONDER_ROOM swaps them afterwards). Only the handleDamage use of the flag was cited; other readers were not searched.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the three listed units are 1-3 stars, so their bare values are 30/60/120. The 240 value (4th column and fallback) is not reachable by their bare star counts. The 4000 ms armor reduction does not vary with stars.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must have a target at range to reach the cast gate).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast refreshes the armor reduction only if the target has no Rune Protect and the new duration is longer, and repeats the damage.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 30/60/120 (1/2/3 stars) and armor reduction 4000 ms (requested). Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor]; the SPE_DEF division uses the halved value only if the armor reduction was actually applied (target without Rune Protect), then ceil, minimum 1 and untraced later modifiers; this is an intermediate calculation, not the final HP loss or takenDamage. Armor reduction: requested 4000 ms, applied duration after reductions that read the target.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after the later handleDamage modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, the armor-reduction halving, the minimum of 1 and the takenDamage accounting were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
